title: fix(fields): a formula reads one stored value the same in the form and in the cell (objectui#11748)
body:
Fixes #11748

Clause-②: no

A formula's value now reads the same in the read-only record form and in a table cell. Implemented by session `session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8` (seat `domain:ui#3`, round 1, claim comment 6027067109).

## What changed

`FormulaField` (`packages/fields/src/widgets/FormulaField.tsx`, the read-only form face) and `FormulaCellRenderer` (`packages/fields/src/index.tsx`, the table face) now read one rule. Each type is drawn through the calls the matching field type's faces make. Both edits sit inside the claim's file surface.

- **Which type.** The declared `returnType`. With none, a JS number is a number and any other value is text. That is the rule objectui#11683 gave the cell, now read by the form too. No type is inferred from the expression.
- **number.** Both faces call `formatNumberFieldValue`, the call the number cell and `NumberField`'s read-only branch make. That gives the locale's grouping and the width a declared `scale` sets. The form face no longer calls `toFixed(2)`. The form now reads the value the way the cell does: blank is empty, and a numeric string under a declared `number` is a number.
- **boolean.** Both faces draw the locale's `common.yes` / `common.no` word. Only a JS boolean is a boolean, as in `BooleanField`'s read-only branch (objectui#8593) and `BooleanCellRenderer` (objectui#8582). Any other value draws `EmptyValue`. The form face used to read truthiness, so the string `'false'` said Yes.
- **date.** Both faces draw `formatDate`'s default face (see the next section). A falsy or unparsable value draws `EmptyValue`, with the same `toDisplayDate` guard as `DateField`'s read-only branch.
- **text.** The cell is unchanged. The form face now takes the cell's emptiness floor and prints the coerced text (the bounded fix below).
- **Monospace** now applies to text only. In the form, the typed results draw in a `text-sm` span, as the field widgets' read-only branches do. In the cell, the date is `tabular-nums`, the boolean word is a plain span, and the number is `NumberCellRenderer` as before.
- **Prose, commit `6865bcd` (the patch round the claim amendment added; no source or test file changed).** Each statement was measured against this branch's code, which that commit does not change, with a throwaway component probe that was never committed.
  - `packages/types/src/field-types.ts` and `packages/types/src/form.ts`: the doc comments on `FormulaFieldMetadata.returnType` and on the form field's `returnType` member said "a number to two decimals, ... anything else as text (the default when it is absent)". They now state the rule above for both faces. Both ship in the `@object-ui/types` declarations, so the changeset adds `'@object-ui/types': patch`.
  - `content/docs/fields/formula.mdx`: the Return Types list said two decimal places, and text as the default with no `returnType`. The Cell Renderer section said the cell is monospace. Both now describe this rule.
  - `content/docs/fields/summary.mdx`: the Cell Renderer comment said the summary cell reads `15750.5` in monospace, which has been false since objectui#11683. It now says `15,750.5` (en-US) through the number cell, not monospace. Measured in en-US and zh-CN on this branch.
  - `.changeset/11748-formula-faces.md`: adds `'@object-ui/types': patch` and one sentence on the doc comments. In the number line, "grouped" becomes "formatted", because a formula declaring `returnType: 'number'` and `scale: 0` reads `2026`, not grouped, in both faces.
  - The nearby `summaryOperations` comment in `form.ts` ("`count` as it arrives, the other four to two decimals") is unchanged. It describes the `SummaryField` widget, which neither this PR nor objectui#11683 touched, and it is still true there.

The rule is written out in both modules. The barrel and the lazily loaded widget may not import each other (the reason `number-format.ts` gives). A shared helper module would be a new file outside the claim, so the equality leg of the new pin file keeps the two copies in step.

No export, prop or language-pack key is added. The diff adds or removes no `export` line, and both component signatures are unchanged. `summary` is still registered to `FormulaCellRenderer`. It declares no `returnType`, so it stays on the no-`returnType` rule.

## The date face: the choice the card left to this PR

**Both faces use `formatDate`'s default face.** It reads `Jul 4` in the current year and `Jul 4, 2020` otherwise, or `7月4日` / `2020年7月4日` in zh-CN. Neither face uses the date cell's relative default (`Today`, `2 days ago`).

Why: the `date` field itself has two faces. Its cell defaults to the relative style, and its read-only form face is `formatDate`'s default. Only the default face exists on both surfaces, so it is the only choice where one stored value reads the same in the form and in the cell. It is also the face `FormulaField` already drew (objectui#8194), and the date cell's own fallback outside the plus-or-minus seven day window.

Cost: within seven days of today, a formula date column reads `Jul 4` where a date column beside it reads `2 days ago`. A pin covers this case ("inside the relative window, the cell keeps the default face").

## The boolean face

The cell draws the word, not `BooleanCellRenderer`'s checkbox. The card's Done-when names "the translated Yes / No" for both faces. A checkbox has no text that could match the form's word.

## Bounded fix inside the claim: the text arm and the empty floor

A component probe on `dd82d4a` measured three more divergences, all on a formula with no `returnType` (form face, then cell):
- the empty string: a blank span with no accessible name, then the `—` affordance;
- the empty list: the same split;
- an expanded record holding a `name` of Ada: `[object Object]`, then `Ada`.

In commit `da0652c` the form face takes the cell's floor (`isEmptyValue` on the coerced value) and prints the coerced text. All four conditions for a bounded fix hold:
- it is the same defect class (one value, two formula faces);
- it is mechanical (the cell's two lines);
- it is in the same file under the same claim;
- it falls under the same gates.

## Pins (en-US and zh-CN, measured on `textContent`)

New: `packages/fields/src/__tests__/formulaFaces.returnType-11748.test.tsx`, 96 tests. Each session sets both the UI language and the display locale, through `I18nProvider` and `LocalizationProvider`.
- **number**, both faces:
  - `returnType: 'number'` reads `200,000`, not `200000.00`;
  - with no `returnType`, a JS number reads `200,000`;
  - a declared `scale: 2` reads `200,000.00`, and a fraction reads `1,234.5`;
  - the text equals the number field's own form and cell faces;
  - no monospace; de-DE reads `200.000`;
  - a declared-number numeric string reads `200,000`, and whitespace draws the affordance, not `0`;
  - control: a string of digits with no `returnType` stays monospace text.
- **boolean**, both faces:
  - `Yes` / `No` and `是` / `否`, equal to `BooleanField`'s read-only word, with no monospace;
  - `'false'`, `'true'`, `0` and `1` draw the affordance;
  - control: `returnType: 'text'` over `true` reads `true`.
- **date**, both faces:
  - a past-year date reads `Jul 4, 2020` / `2020年7月4日`, equal to `formatDate`'s default and to `DateField`'s read-only face, with no monospace;
  - an unparsable value draws the affordance;
  - with the clock pinned two days after the value, the formula cell reads `Jul 4` / `7月4日` while the date cell reads its relative phrase.
- **text**, both faces: the empty string and the empty list draw the affordance; a record reads its name; a declared `text` over a number stays monospace `200000`.
- **The equality leg:** 13 (`returnType`, value) rows in each of the two sessions. The form's text must equal the cell's text, not a literal, so a change that moves only one face goes red.

Updated: `packages/fields/src/widgets/__tests__/formula-summary-spec-reads-11070.test.tsx`.
- The `'3.00'` pin asserted the retired `toFixed(2)` face. It now asserts a numeric string: `1,234.5` under a declared number, `1234.5` with none.
- The `return_type`-retirement control now uses a numeric string. A JS number no longer separates "read" from "ignored", because both read `3`.

## Premise check, on `db4cb6b` before any edit

The new pin file ran against unchanged code and failed 51 of 86 tests (35 passed). In the form it read `200000.00`, `200000` and `1234.50`. In the cell it read `true` (en-US and zh-CN) and `2020-07-04`, all in monospace. In the form, the string `'false'` under `returnType: 'boolean'` drew a word, not the affordance.

## Measured, on head `da0652c`

|---|---|---|
| `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/fields/src/widgets/` | 0 | `Test Files 112 passed (112)`, `Tests 1051 passed (1051)` |
| `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/fields/src/__tests__/` plus the 9 test files directly under `packages/fields/src/` | 0 | `Test Files 127 passed, 1 skipped (128)`, `Tests 2768 passed, 7 skipped (2775)` |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check` | 0 | echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; `--listFilesOnly` on the test program lists both changed test files |
| `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over 49 consumer files (below) | 0 | `Test Files 49 passed (49)`, `Tests 1030 passed (1030)` |
| `pnpm exec eslint` on the 4 changed source files | 0 | 0 errors; no warning falls inside a changed hunk |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` / `check:test-path-roots` / `check:changeset-claims` / `check:pending-changeset-literals` / `check:new-line-citations` / `check:vi-mock-specifiers` / `check:comment-mask-corpus` / `check:esm-specifiers` / `check:self-import` / `check:phantom-deps` / `check:unreferenced-sources` | 0 each | `check:changeset-claims`: "No pending changeset names a file this change touches." `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` / `-no-major` / `-fixed` / `-overwrite` | 0 each | presence: "4 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)" |
| `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/fields^...' build` | 0 | 9 packages, on `dd82d4a`; no dependency changed after it |

The two package-suite halves together cover all 240 test files under `packages/fields` (119 + 112 + 9). The suite was split because a single run held the lock for 9 minutes 5 seconds on `dd82d4a` (exit 0, 239 passed and 1 skipped), too close to the foreground cap.

Consumer selection: every test file under `apps/console`, `packages/app-shell`, `packages/components`, `packages/react` and `packages/plugin-*` that contains the word `formula` (a `git grep -l -i`), less metadata-admin and plugin-designer. That is a declared narrowing: the public surface is byte-unchanged, so the rest of the farm is left to CI. Heavy runs went through `os-verify-lock.sh`, and the times above are shared-box times.

NOT MEASURED:
- `check:eager-closure`: PREREQUISITE NOT MET, because it needs a built `apps/console` bundle. The barrel's imports are unchanged. `FormulaField` now also imports `number-format.js`, `coerceToSafeValue.js` and core's `isEmptyValue`, and all three are already in the barrel's eager closure.
- `check:readme-exports`: exit 1 with "404 self-import(s) could not be judged", because no `dist` type entries are built. This gate is only owed when exports change, and none did.

## Ablation (one-time proof; no permanent test added)

Each mutation was made from a committed head through `ablation-replace.mjs`, which ran the new pin file and then restored the file. Every restore was proven: blob equal to `HEAD`, and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The pins import the units by relative path (`../index`, `../widgets/FormulaField`), so the ablations read `src`, and `dist` is not involved.

| mutation | head | result |
|---|---|---|
| cell date arm drawn by `DateCellRenderer` (the relative face) | `dd82d4a` | 2 failed, 84 passed: exactly the two relative-window pins |
| form number arm `formatNumberFieldValue(num, field, locale)` becomes `num.toFixed(2)` | `dd82d4a` | 18 failed, 68 passed, including the number rows of the equality leg |
| cell boolean word becomes `String(value)` | `dd82d4a` | 8 failed, 78 passed, including the boolean rows of the equality leg |
| form floor `isEmptyValue(safe)` becomes `value == null` | `da0652c` | 5 failed, 91 passed: the empty-string and empty-list equality rows and the form affordance pin |

Each direction was predicted before its run. Past-year dates stay green under the first mutation because the relative face falls back to the default face outside its window.

## Acceptance notes

- `content/docs/fields/summary.mdx`, in its "Cell Renderer" section, said the summary cell renders "monospace text: 15750.5", which has been false since objectui#11683. It was corrected in commit `6865bcd` (see What changed). The summary field's own two faces still disagree (the form widget prints `toFixed(2)`). That is filed as objectui#11752. (Edited by `domain:ui` seat 3, `session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`, after the patch round.)
- The pending changeset `.changeset/11683-formula-datetime-cell-text.md` says any other declared `returnType` "is drawn as before". This PR makes that untrue for `boolean` and `date`. Rather than edit another card's entry, this PR's changeset says so in its last paragraph.
- The barrel's emptiness-floor table (the objectui#8496 block) lists `FormulaCellRenderer` under "the floor exactly", with a note about its number arm. Past the floor, the new boolean and date arms also draw the affordance for a non-boolean or unparsable value. The table is now incomplete but not false. It sits outside `FormulaCellRenderer`, so it was left alone.
- The number field's own two faces disagree on a numeric string. `NumberField`'s read-only branch prints it as it arrives, and `NumberCellRenderer` formats it. A formula declared `number` follows the cell's reading in both faces, so the formula's two faces agree. The number field's own split belongs to that field, not to this card.
- Not in this card: a currency display for formulas. The spec's `returnType` has no currency member.
